title: FBI Photo B006
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white surveillance/targeting camera still with crosshair overlay and redaction bars
pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or surveillance display. A white crosshair reticle is centered, with graduated tick marks and numeric labels reading 15, 10, 5 on both sides of the horizontal axis. Near the top center, above the vertical crosshair, is a small dark blurry object. Several solid black rectangular bars (apparent redactions or overlays) are placed along the left and right edges and across the top of the frame. A timestamp in white text appears in the lower-left corner. The overall background is mottled gray with visible image noise.

observations.claim: A white crosshair reticle is centered in the image
Numeric scale markings read 15, 10, 5 on both sides of the horizontal axis
A timestamp '12/31/99 18:10:00' is displayed in the lower-left corner
Multiple solid black rectangular bars appear along the edges and top
A small dark blurry object sits above the center of the crosshair
The image is grayscale with visible grain/noise
